source.title: GitHub sub-issues.
source.body:
1. Design Luxury Black and Gold Homepage
Writing
Objective
Design and develop a premium, professional homepage for OLAMILEKAN GLOBAL WORLD.
Requirements
Luxury black-and-metallic-gold design.
Professional company logo and branding.
Tagline: One World. Your Vision.
Attractive welcome section.
Company introduction.
Business divisions and services.
Featured products.
WhatsApp contact button.
Mobile-friendly navigation.
Responsive design for phones, tablets and computers.
Expected Result
A modern, attractive international business homepage.
2. Build About Us and Company Profile
Writing
Objective
Create a professional company profile page.
Requirements
Company name: OLAMILEKAN GLOBAL WORLD.
Founder profile.
Company background.
Vision and mission.
Business objectives.
Company values.
International business focus.
Professional black-and-gold presentation.
Expected Result
A complete company profile that communicates the company's identity and vision.
3. Build Technology Store and Product Catalogue
Writing
Objective
Create an online technology store.
Products
iPhones.
Android smartphones.
iPads and tablets.
Laptops and computers.
Phone accessories.
Electronics.
Requirements
Product images.
Product descriptions.
Prices in Nigerian Naira.
Product categories.
WhatsApp ordering.
Mobile-friendly catalogue.
Expected Result
A professional technology shopping catalogue.
4. Build Online Supermarket
Writing
Objective
Develop an online supermarket for everyday shopping.
Products
Rice and food items.
Groceries.
Beverages.
Household essentials.
Personal care products.
Kitchen supplies.
Requirements
Product categories.
Product images and descriptions.
Naira pricing.
WhatsApp ordering.
Delivery information.
Expected Result
A convenient online supermarket catalogue.
5. Build African Products Marketplace
Writing
Objective
Create a marketplace showcasing African products to local and international customers.
Requirements
African food products.
African fashion.
Traditional crafts.
African-made goods.
Wholesale and retail opportunities.
Supplier information.
Product descriptions and images.
WhatsApp enquiries.
Expected Result
A marketplace connecting African products with global customers.
6. Build Logistics and International Trade Pages
Writing
Objective
Create professional logistics and international trade information pages.
Requirements
Logistics services information.
Delivery services.
Import and export information.
International trade opportunities.
Supplier sourcing.
Business partnerships.
Global market expansion information.
Expected Result
A professional platform introducing the company's logistics and international trade services.
7. Add WhatsApp, Email and Contact Features
Writing
Objective
Make it easy for customers and business partners to contact the company.
Official Contact Details
WhatsApp: +2348025592137
Email: olalekanb817@gmail.com
Requirements
WhatsApp chat button.
Email contact link.
Contact form.
Business enquiry section.
Mobile-friendly contact page.
Clear call-to-action buttons.
Expected Result
Working contact features that allow customers to make enquiries and place orders.
8. Fix Website Issues and Deploy with GitHub Pages
Writing
Objective
Test, correct and publish the completed OLAMILEKAN GLOBAL WORLD website.
Requirements
Check all HTML files.
Fix CSS and JavaScript errors.
Check navigation links.
Test mobile responsiveness.
Test WhatsApp buttons.
Test email links.
Check website loading speed.
Configure GitHub Pages.
Verify custom domain configuration.
Enable HTTPS.
Resolve 404 and deployment errors.
Free Hosting
GitHub Pages.
Repository
olalekanb816-cell/olamilekanglobalworld
Expected Result
A fully working, publicly accessible website with free hostinge
